BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ROCHESTER PUBLIC UTILITIES; REFUNDABLE SALES AND USE TAX EXEMPTION FOR ELECTRIC METERS AND SOFTWARE. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Exemption; refund.+]

[+(a) Electric meters, software, and other components are exempt if used or consumed in the Rochester Public Utilities Advanced Metering Infrastructure Project and purchased after June 30, 2024, and before March 31, 2029. +]

[+(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2024, and before March 31, 2029. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing an exemption for certain electric meters and software used in the Rochester Public Utilities Advanced Metering Infrastructure Project.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ROCHESTER PUBLIC UTILITIES; REFUNDABLE SALES AND USE TAX EXEMPTION FOR ELECTRIC METERS AND SOFTWARE.

Subdivision 1.

Exemption; refund.

(a) Electric meters, software, and other components are exempt if used or consumed in the Rochester Public Utilities Advanced Metering Infrastructure Project and purchased after June 30, 2024, and before March 31, 2029.

(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17).

Subd. 2.

Appropriation.

The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after June 30, 2024, and before March 31, 2029.
